data.content:
Back-to-back home wins over Grimsby (1-0) and Chesterfield (1-0) have moved Port Vale clear of the drop zone. The Valiants have now won three home matches on the spin by the same scoreline, however, they have lost 100% of their six away games in all competitions since the summer, and their travel sickness is unlikely to end on Tuesday.

Score prediction: Gillingham 1-0 Port Vale

### Gillingham vs Port Vale (Tuesday, 8:00 pm) [...] Gillingham’s upswing in results in September has been followed by an inconsistent October, much to manager Gareth Ainsworth’s frustration. Their display in a 3-1 loss at Accrington Stanley on Saturday was well below standard, though the Gills have kept three clean sheets in a row at home, with those shutouts earning them seven points from nine at the Priestfield Stadium.
